# Herbfield Lane · Venture brief

A fragment, not a Session 0 transcript. It carries the sections
`activate --brief` reads and nothing else, so a change to the facts
block is visible in the test rather than buried in a full brief.

## What it is

A sole trader's brochure site with contact details and no accounts.

## Venture facts

The same answers again, as the names `kernel/PREDICATES.md` gives them,
one per line.

```facts
runs_agents
has_user_interface
hosts_service
publishes_public_content
collects_contact_details
```

## Material workstreams

- The pages themselves.
- The contact route, and where those details go.
